title: The draft-PR refusal names the GitHub MCP form (draft: true), not the gh CLI draft flag
why: Coordinator 16:52 CST Nov 10, from lane guard-matcher-github-mcp (#2571, batch 75): DRAFT_PR_REASON in hooks/guard_merge.py names the gh CLI create command with its draft flag, but the cloud refuses gh writes; after #2571 lands this remedy shows on every non-draft MCP create.
note: A debt once #2571 lands. Note from the same lane: the matcher test's scan skips other guard_*.py files and misses a tool compared to a constant until the constant joins GUARD_NAMES or MERGE_NAMES.
